messages.content: Avoid these words/phrases completely: ['world']. Use at most 130 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words like "you're" are allowed.) The final line of your response must be exactly: "The outer solar system has many unexplored areas.". No tables. Avoid table-like formatting.

Write a casual blog post about how the outer solar system is different from the inner solar system, and what that means for the possibility of life. Finish with "The outer solar system has many interesting places to explore." and don’t add anything after it. Your response must contain a Markdown-style table. If you include a table, use a Markdown table (pipes '|' plus a dashed separator row). Keep it to 130 words or fewer. (Words are made of English letters; apostrophes inside a word are allowed.) Include all of these keywords or phrases at least once: ['world', 'surface'].
